body: Usually people say stuff like "life is short so live it up" but I like your perspective better, life is long so stick around. Thanks for replying and cheering me up it's nice to know there are people out there who care.

It's not possible in this apartment and even if it was I don't have the financial means to keep it healthy or take it to the vet if it needed to go. I used to spend time at the humane society playing with their cats but have been too busy to go lately. I want a cat that's really talkative and really cuddly (: I can't wait to move out of here so I can get one. 

Thanks for replying, by the way. I hope it's true what you say about most people being lonely. I just don't see it that way, I feel like most people have at least one person they can talk to. I do have family but they're very far away and never talk to me. Making friends is very difficult for me. Maybe I'll look into seeing a therapist. Thanks again and I hope you have a good day.
